title: Linguine alle Cozze
subtitle: Linguine with mussels in white wine and parsley
excerpt: Fresh mussels steamed open in white wine and garlic, then tossed with linguine and a good handful of flat-leaf parsley. Light, briny, and quick to bring together.
sourceNotes: Classic Neapolitan seafood pasta; mussels and linguine in white wine are a staple of Italian coastal cooking.

content.text: This is a quick coastal Italian pasta that relies entirely on fresh mussels. Scrub them well and discard any that stay shut after cooking. The mussel liquor becomes your sauce.

items.prepNote: scrubbed, beards removed, discard any open ones that don't close when tapped
juice only, plus wedges to serve

content.text: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil. Cook the linguine until al dente. Reserve a large mug of pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a wide pan with a lid. Add the garlic and chilli flakes. Cook over a medium heat for 1 minute.
Turn the heat up high. Add the mussels and pour in the wine. Put the lid on immediately.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, shaking the pan once or twice, until all the mussels have opened. Discard any that remain shut.
Remove half the mussels from their shells if you like a neater dish. Leave the rest in the shell for presentation.
Add the drained linguine to the mussel pan. Add the remaining olive oil and a good splash of pasta water. Toss well over a low heat for 1 minute.
Add the parsley and a squeeze of lemon if using. Season with black pepper. Serve straight away.

items.symptom: Many mussels stayed shut after cooking.
items.cause: They were not live when you started, or the pan was not hot enough.
items.fix: Discard any closed mussels. Make sure the pan and wine are at a full boil before adding the mussels.

items.cause: Mussels release a lot of briny liquid and the pasta water adds more salt.
items.fix: Do not salt the pasta water as heavily as usual. Taste the mussel liquor before adding any extra seasoning.

items.cause: The pasta was not added with enough pasta water.
items.fix: Add more of the reserved pasta water a splash at a time and toss over a low heat until the sauce coats the strands.
